development_note: Before the faculty matrix/test began, the independent consumer-CPU validation pilot showed reasonable wind marginals but lag-1 correlation 0.976 versus observed 0.913. A six-variant final matrix therefore adds a 2-hour latent-resolution counterpart to the 8-hour prior-matching model. Both have 8760 latent elements and approximately 0.17 million parameters; this is a validation-informed architecture experiment, not an assertion that all choices preceded every pilot observation. No test metrics were used.
purpose: Bounded H2RES annual climate CVAE study; exploratory model development, followed by one frozen test evaluation
compact_local_data_storage: Lazy overlapping views of one normalized training series with the same 1826 window positions and calendar values, avoiding eager duplication; other variants retain the legacy eager representation
legacy_epoch_cap: Original-loss variants retain the 100-epoch schedule and stop by 100 epochs even in a longer-budget confirmation, avoiding unintended cosine-schedule cycling beyond the preserved horizon.
prior_matching_variant: Same local architecture as compact_local_balanced, plus 0.5 times unpaired prior marginal/moment/spectral/ACF/cross-channel constraints, linearly introduced over 10 epochs. Random prior paths are never forced to align hourly with an unrelated observed weather path. Fixed-noise validation objective includes the full additional term. No test values enter optimization.
aggregate_prior_diagnostic: For original global-CVAE checkpoints only, fit a Gaussian approximation to the aggregate posterior of the 36 annual training years: covariance of posterior means with fixed 0.1 diagonal shrinkage plus mean diagonal sampling-posterior variance. Evaluate this explicitly named post-hoc sampler separately, using the same decoder and sample seeds. No validation/test values enter fitting; it is not standard-normal prior generation. Practical seed-17 checkpoint recommendation may include this sampler, but bounded variant ranking remains based on the standard prior.
selection_score: Mean over individual validation years, prior seeds and channels of Wasserstein/train_std + 0.25*abs(generated_std/real_std-1) + 0.25*abs(generated_p99-real_p99)/train_std + 0.5*mean(abs(generated_ACF-real_ACF) at lags 1,24,168). Lower is better. Equal channel weighting.
diversity_sanity_check: For automatic standard-prior variant selection, every training seed must have mean pointwise standard deviation across its three T=1 prior paths of at least 1% of training standard deviation in each channel. This is a declared non-degeneracy check, not a calibrated uncertainty or physical adequacy guarantee.
selection: Mean validation score across all three training seeds. Failed trials remain in tables and disqualify a variant from automatic selection. No test-based selection.
deployment_checkpoint: For practical deployment compare validation scores of seed 17 only: the preserved 100-epoch reference, the selected variant's bounded run and its confirmation run. Recommend the lowest validation score, record that this is single-checkpoint selection, and freeze it before test. Benchmark comparisons still retain every seed.
portable_checkpoint: Separately retain the qualifying compact variant with the lowest three-seed mean validation score under the original 900-second matrix budget. Use its fixed seed-17 bounded checkpoint, not a best test seed or a longer-budget checkpoint. Export it and include its small weights even when a large checkpoint has the best measured quality. If different from the overall selected variant, add a separate 180-second one-thread CPU feasibility measurement before test freeze.

confirmation.variant: validation-selected variant, trained again from scratch

cpu_feasibility.purpose: Measured bounded CPU training; no extrapolation presented as a completed CPU run

optional_laptop_trial.selection_role: Additional practical consumer-laptop feasibility/quality measurement; excluded from faculty variant ranking and checkpoint recommendation. Include in frozen test only if its completed checkpoint is transferred before freeze.

test_evaluation: Freeze selection and checkpoint hashes before opening test metrics. Evaluate reference, all bounded-study trials, confirmation trials and a calendar-aligned training-year resampling comparator with the same evaluator. Do not tune after test.
limitations: One dataset and one GPU; no universal optimality claim
2020-2024 is the project's previously used fixed reporting period, held out from fitting and selection in this new experiment, not a globally untouched test set
Reference 100-epoch run has a different total budget from bounded trials
Architecture and objective improvements are combined in local balanced variant
Training-year resampling comparator is not the current full XGBoost/bootstrap H2RES pipeline
No Gurobi solve or system-level economic outcome is inferred
New 2026 reconstruction cannot establish the sole cause of historical failure
